question: Q4
hypothesis: Appending a one-line inline example to a mid-compliance duty rule raises compliance, because the example shows exactly what a satisfying edit looks like.

variants.no-example: - Every error message thrown in src/ files starts with an uppercase snake-case error code followed by a colon.
variants.example: - Every error message thrown in src/ files starts with an uppercase snake-case error code followed by a colon, e.g. `E_NOT_FOUND: settings file missing`.

tasks.prompt: Implement `loadSettings(filePath)` in src/settings.js: read the file synchronously, parse it as JSON, apply defaults ({ theme: "dark", autosave: true }) for missing keys, and throw a clear error when the file is missing or the JSON is malformed. Export it from the module. Do not add tests.

variants.no-example: - List every exported src/ function in docs/api.md.
variants.example: - List every exported src/ function in docs/api.md, e.g. `- slugify(title) — turn a title into a URL slug.`

tasks.prompt: Implement `clamp(n, min, max)` in src/num.js: return n limited to the inclusive range [min, max]. Export it from the module. Do not add tests.

variants.no-example: - When you change a file in src/, note the change as a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md.
variants.example: - When you change a file in src/, note the change as a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, e.g. `- Added retry handling to the fetch helper.`

tasks.prompt: Implement `slugify(title)` in src/text.js: lowercase the string, trim it, replace runs of spaces with single dashes, and strip every character that is not a letter, digit, or dash. Export it from the module. Do not add tests.
